name: acerola
description: Aplicativo para ler e gerenciar bibliotecas de quadrinhos locais.

scripts.check: npm run paraglide:compile && svelte-kit sync && svelte-check --tsconfig ./tsconfig.json
scripts.check:watch: npm run paraglide:compile && svelte-kit sync && svelte-check --tsconfig ./tsconfig.json --watch
scripts.test: npm run paraglide:compile && svelte-kit sync && vitest run
scripts.test:watch: npm run paraglide:compile && svelte-kit sync && vitest
scripts.test:unit: npm run paraglide:compile && svelte-kit sync && vitest run --project=unit
scripts.test:coverage: npm run paraglide:compile && svelte-kit sync && vitest run --coverage
scripts.test:unit:watch: npm run paraglide:compile && svelte-kit sync && vitest --project=unit
scripts.test:integration: npm run paraglide:compile && svelte-kit sync && vitest run --project=integration
scripts.test:storybook: npm run paraglide:compile && svelte-kit sync && vitest run --project=storybook
scripts.test:storybook:watch: npm run paraglide:compile && svelte-kit sync && vitest --project=storybook
scripts.test:coverage:unit: npm run paraglide:compile && svelte-kit sync && vitest run --project=unit --coverage
scripts.test:all: npm run test:unit && npm run test:e2e && npm run test:wdio
scripts.test:ui: npm run paraglide:compile && svelte-kit sync && vitest --ui
scripts.test:mutation: npm run paraglide:compile && svelte-kit sync && stryker run
